note: Which colour family each card of a list wears (src/lib/design/cardColours.ts, round 5 B3; read by cardColours.test.ts on the web and by the apps' CardPalette tests). Families are palette indices in `hues` order (CARD_HUES). A card prefers the family nearest its cover's `accentHue` (equally near: the earlier family), or, with none (null), `position mod 6`. Walking the list in order, a card whose preference one of the `window` cards before it already wears takes the first family of `order[preference]` (the other five, nearest hue first, ties by lower index) that none of them wears. `palettes`: the expected family of each card. `pages`: page sizes loaded one after another — colouring each prefix alone must give the same families as the whole list. `columns`: the grid this case is also checked as (row-major: card i in column i mod columns) — no two cards in a row and no card and the one above share a family; every case holds for 1, 2 and 3 columns.

no cover hue anywhere: by position, as before — six in a row never clash
